nodes.description: address public owner of the Owned contract; set from msg.sender in the constructor and updated in acceptOwnership.
address public newOwner used as the two-step ownership handover slot.
string public symbol of the YFFFARM token, set to 'YFF' in the constructor.
string public name of the YFFFARM token, set to 'YFF Farm' in the constructor.
uint8 public decimals of the token, set to 8.
uint public _totalSupply, initialized to 6000000000000 and used by totalSupply().
mapping(address => uint) balances holding token balances; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed holding ERC20 allowances; mutated by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
SafeMath.safeAdd: pure helper performing a + b with an overflow require.
SafeMath.safeSub: pure helper performing a - b with an underflow require.
SafeMath.safeMul: pure helper performing a * b with an overflow require.
SafeMath.safeDiv: pure helper performing a / b with a divide-by-zero require.
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function setting newOwner to begin a two-step ownership transfer.
Completes ownership transfer when called by newOwner and resets newOwner to zero.
YFFFARM constructor: sets symbol, name, decimals and mints the whole _totalSupply to a fixed address.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Spends an allowance to move tokens from 'from' to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets the allowance then calls receiveApproval on the arbitrary spender contract.
Payable fallback that immediately reverts, rejecting plain ETH.
onlyOwner rescue that calls transfer on an arbitrary token address for the owner.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller identity used for balances, allowances and ownership checks.
Arithmetic addition a + b inside safeAdd guarded by require(c >= a).
Arithmetic subtraction a - b inside safeSub guarded by require(b <= a).
Arithmetic multiplication a * b inside safeMul guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Arithmetic division a / b inside safeDiv guarded by require(b > 0).
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an attacker-controlled address before state finalization.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary attacker-supplied token contract.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as the initial owner in the Owned constructor.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner to authorize transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, a caller-identity authorization check.
transfer reads and writes balances[msg.sender], the caller-controlled account.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] keyed by the untrusted caller.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] using the untrusted caller.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callee.
onlyOwner gate on transferAnyERC20Token verifies msg.sender == owner.

parameter to is the credited account in transferFrom.
parameter tokens is the amount moved in transferFrom.

parameter spender indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.

parameter data is forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval call.
parameter tokenAddress is the target contract of the external transfer call.
parameter tokens is the amount forwarded to the external token transfer.
safeAdd executes the a + b addition guarded only by require(c >= a).
safeSub executes the a - b subtraction guarded only by require(b <= a).
safeMul executes the a * b multiplication guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
safeDiv executes the a / b division guarded by require(b > 0).
approveAndCall performs an external call to an arbitrary spender contract during execution.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary token contract.
The malicious spender contract invoked by receiveApproval can re-enter transfer before approveAndCall returns.
The malicious spender contract invoked by receiveApproval can re-enter transferFrom using the freshly granted allowance.
A malicious tokenAddress contract can call back into transfer during the rescue external call.
A malicious tokenAddress contract can call back into transferFrom during the rescue external call.
Owned constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes _newOwner into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
YFFFARM constructor initializes _totalSupply.
YFFFARM constructor mints the full supply into balances of the fixed holder address.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer mutates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
approve mutates the allowed mapping.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping for from and to.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping for the caller.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
